checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RAW-INPUT: SSZ schema validation before state mutation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send SSZ-encoded data with extra fields not in the Deneb schema. Verify rejection. 2. Send SSZ data with missing required fields. Verify rejection. 3. Send SSZ data with correct schema but wrong fork version. Verify rejection. 4. Verify no state mutation occurs for any rejected message. 5. Test with SSZ data containing maximum-length variable lists to probe allocation limits.
executable_checks: Send SSZ with extra trailing fields and assert rejection before state mutation
Send SSZ with missing required field and assert rejection
Verify node state unchanged after all malformed SSZ attempts
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-DENEBLCP2P-PRECOND-003. Boundary: EXT-P2P-PEER-LC-GOSSIP -> CL. Trust model: must validate fork digest before deserialization, reject malformed messages with peer scoring.

checklist.title: Verify SSZ schema validation rejects non-Deneb fields
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a Capella-format LC message and send during Deneb epoch. Verify rejection. 2. Construct a message with Deneb fields plus hypothetical future-fork fields. Verify rejection. 3. Verify the validation step occurs before any other processing.
executable_checks: Send Capella-era SSZ to Deneb node and assert schema rejection
Verify validation ordering: schema check before crypto verification
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-DENEBLCP2P-PRECOND-003. Supporting node check for boundary EDGE-RAW-INPUT.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-BOOTSTRAP-RESP: bootstrap slot range validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a bootstrap response with header slot set to current_slot + 100 (future). Verify rejection. 2. Send bootstrap with slot before Deneb fork activation. Verify rejection. 3. Send bootstrap with valid slot range. Verify acceptance and further validation proceeds. 4. Send bootstrap with slot = 0. Verify rejection.
executable_checks: Send bootstrap with future slot and assert rejection
Send bootstrap with pre-Deneb slot and assert rejection
Send bootstrap with valid-range slot and assert processing continues
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-DENEBLCP2P-PRECOND-004. Boundary: EXT-P2P-PEER-LC-REQRESP -> CL. Trust model: must validate fork version, SSZ, and crypto proofs. Related: ASSUM-DENEB-LC-P2P-02.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-RESPONDS: deposit snapshot Merkle root verification
checklist.bug_class: Merkle Proof Forgery / Trust Boundary Violation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Provide a deposit snapshot with a Merkle root that does not match recomputation from finalized deposits. Verify rejection. 2. Provide a snapshot with correct root but tampered deposit data. Verify detection via recomputation mismatch. 3. Provide a snapshot with deposit count exceeding the finalized count. Verify rejection. 4. Provide a valid snapshot and verify acceptance.
executable_checks: Send snapshot with incorrect Merkle root and assert rejection
Send snapshot with tampered deposit data and assert root mismatch detection
Send snapshot with valid data and assert acceptance
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP4881-PRECOND-003. Boundary: EXT-BEACON-PEER-SNAPSHOT -> CL. Trust model: must recalculate deposit root and compare against weak subjectivity checkpoint. Related: ASSUM-EIP4881-02.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-START-VALIDATION: Cancun block header field validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a block header with parent_hash not matching any known block. Verify rejection. 2. Submit header with timestamp <= parent timestamp. Verify rejection. 3. Submit header with base_fee_per_gas computed incorrectly from parent. Verify rejection. 4. Submit header with non-zero difficulty (post-merge violation). Verify rejection. 5. Submit valid header and verify acceptance into validation pipeline.
executable_checks: Send header with unknown parent_hash and assert rejection
Send header with timestamp <= parent.timestamp and assert rejection
Send header with wrong base_fee_per_gas and assert rejection
Send header with difficulty != 0 and assert rejection
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CANCUNBLK-PRECOND-003. Boundary: EXT-NETWORK-PEER-BLOCKS -> EL. Trust model: full header validation required before processing.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ATTACKER-DEPOSITS: activation queue bypass prevention
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit 1000 valid deposits in a single epoch from attacker-controlled keys. 2. Verify all deposits enter the activation queue. 3. Verify the per-epoch activation limit (churn limit) is enforced. 4. Verify no deposits bypass the queue regardless of deposit amount or timing. 5. Compute expected activation delay and verify it matches actual delay.
executable_checks: Submit bulk deposits and verify all enter activation queue
Verify per-epoch churn limit bounds the activation rate
Assert no deposit activates before its queue position
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP6916-PRECOND-003. Boundary: EXT-ATTACKER-TESTNET -> CL. Trust model: reset period must be shorter than validator takeover timeline.

checklist.title: Falsify: Execution engine trusts CL-provided access list without independent validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Provide an access list via CL that includes storage keys NOT actually accessed by the transaction. 2. Verify the execution engine independently validates which keys are actually accessed. 3. Provide an access list missing keys that ARE accessed. 4. Verify the missing keys are charged at cold access cost (2600 gas), not warm (100 gas). 5. Verify the EE does not blindly trust CL validation.
executable_checks: Submit tx with access list containing unaccessed keys and verify correct gas accounting
Submit tx missing accessed keys from access list and verify cold gas charges
Verify EE performs independent access tracking
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7928-PRECOND-004. Pre-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-EE-VALIDATE-ACCESS-LIST. Related: AMB-EIP7928-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: EIP-196 precompile returns partial results on failure instead of consuming all gas
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ECADD (0x06) with a point NOT on the curve. Verify all gas consumed and empty return. 2. Call ECMUL (0x07) with invalid point. Verify same behavior. 3. Call pairing (0x08) with invalid point. Verify same behavior. 4. Verify no data in the output buffer after failure (not partial coordinates or error codes). 5. Check remaining gas after failed call equals gas before call minus all provided gas.
executable_checks: Call ECADD with off-curve point and assert empty return + all gas consumed
Call ECMUL with off-curve point and assert empty return + all gas consumed
Verify return buffer is empty (length 0) not zero-filled
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP196-INV-002. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-PRECOMPILE-FAILED. Related: AMB-EIP196-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: Memory expansion cost deviates from quadratic formula
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Expand memory to 32 bytes (1 word). Verify cost = 1/512 + 3 = 3 gas. 2. Expand to 1024 bytes (32 words). Verify cost = 32^2/512 + 3*32 = 2 + 96 = 98 gas. 3. Expand to 32768 bytes (1024 words). Verify cost = 1024^2/512 + 3*1024 = 2048 + 3072 = 5120 gas. 4. Test at the boundary where cost increment causes OOG. 5. Verify incremental cost (expanding from N to N+1 words) matches formula difference.
executable_checks: Expand to 1 word and assert gas cost matches formula
Expand to 32 words and assert gas cost matches formula
Expand to 1024 words and assert gas cost matches formula
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CANCUNMEM-INV-001. Invariant falsification. Formula: cost = words^2/512 + 3*words. Related: AMB-CANCUN-MEM-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Deposit tree pruning removes nodes referenced by pending deposits
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Append deposits to the tree. Finalize only a subset. 2. Trigger pruning. 3. Verify deposits in the non-finalized range still have valid Merkle proofs. 4. Verify pruned nodes are only from the fully finalized range. 5. Attempt to generate a Merkle proof for a pending deposit after pruning and verify success.
executable_checks: Prune after partial finalization and verify pending deposit proofs still valid
Verify pruned nodes are exclusively from finalized range
Generate Merkle proof for non-finalized deposit post-prune and assert success
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP4881-INV-002. Invariant falsification. Primary element: ACTION-PRUNE-TREE. Related: AMB-EIP4881-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: Testnet reset period configured outside valid bounds
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Configure reset_period = 0 epochs. Verify rejection or error. 2. Configure reset_period exceeding weak subjectivity period. Verify rejection or warning. 3. Configure valid reset_period and verify acceptance. 4. Verify reset period bounds are enforced at startup, not just at reset time.
executable_checks: Set reset_period=0 and assert configuration error
Set reset_period > weak_subjectivity_period and assert warning/rejection
Set valid reset_period and assert acceptance
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP6916-INV-001. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-RESET-PERIOD. Related: AMB-EIP6916-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Memory access at offset > 2^32 succeeds without OOG
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Attempt MSTORE at offset 2^32 with 30M gas. Verify out-of-gas due to quadratic cost. 2. Attempt MLOAD at offset 2^33. Verify OOG. 3. Compute the gas cost for accessing offset 2^32 and verify it exceeds any practical gas limit. 4. Verify that 256-bit offset values are handled without integer overflow in the gas calculation.
executable_checks: MSTORE at offset 2^32 with max gas and assert OOG
Verify gas calculation does not overflow for large offsets
Verify no memory is actually allocated for OOG attempts
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EVMMEM-INV-002. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-MEMORY-ADDRESS-SPACE. Related: AMB-MEMORY-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: CL accepts block despite state root mismatch from execution engine
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Have the execution engine return VALID status but with a state root that differs from the block header. 2. Verify the CL independently checks the state root against the header. 3. Verify block rejection despite EE's VALID status. 4. Test with matching state root and verify block acceptance.
executable_checks: Submit block with EE VALID but wrong state root and assert CL rejection
Submit block with matching state root and EE VALID and assert acceptance
Verify CL performs independent state root comparison
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7928-INV-002. Invariant falsification. Primary element: ACTION-VERIFY-STATE-ROOT. Related: ASSUM-EIP7928-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: EIP-196 precompile outputs differ across client implementations
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute ECADD with known test vectors on 2+ client implementations. Compare outputs byte-by-byte. 2. Execute ECMUL with the generator point and scalar k on multiple clients. Compare. 3. Execute pairing check with known valid/invalid pairings. Compare boolean results. 4. Test edge cases: point at infinity input, scalar = curve order, maximum coordinate values.
executable_checks: ECADD test vector comparison across 2+ clients
ECMUL with generator point across 2+ clients
Pairing check with known vectors across 2+ clients
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP196-INV-004. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-CURVE-PARAMS. Related: ASSUM-EIP196-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Precompile address mapping changes within a fork's lifetime
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Query the precompile mapping at block N. Record all address-to-implementation entries. 2. Process 1000 blocks within the same fork. Re-query the mapping. 3. Verify byte-identical mapping at both points. 4. Attempt to deploy EVM bytecode at a precompile address. Verify it does not override the native implementation. 5. Verify CALL to precompile address always executes native code, not any deployed bytecode.
executable_checks: Compare precompile mapping at block N and N+1000 within same fork
Deploy bytecode at precompile address and verify native still executes
Verify mapping consistency across node restart
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-PRECOMP-INV-003. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-PRECOMPILE-MAP. Related: ASSUM-MAPPING-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Memory write executes before gas is charged for expansion
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute MSTORE at a large offset with barely insufficient gas for the expansion cost. 2. Verify the transaction reverts with OOG. 3. Verify memory was NOT modified (no partial write occurred). 4. Check that the state after OOG matches state before the MSTORE attempt. 5. Test with CALLDATACOPY and MCOPY at expansion-triggering offsets.
executable_checks: MSTORE with insufficient expansion gas and assert OOG without memory modification
Verify state rollback on OOG during memory expansion
MCOPY triggering expansion with insufficient gas and verify clean OOG
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CANCUNMEM-INV-004. Invariant falsification. Primary element: ACTION-CHARGE-MEM-GAS. Related: ASSUM-CANCUN-MEM-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Client proceeds with conflicting snapshots from all peers without fallback
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Connect the client to 3 peers, each providing a different (conflicting) deposit snapshot. 2. Verify the client detects the conflict. 3. Verify the client falls back to full deposit log replay from a trusted EL endpoint. 4. Verify the client does NOT proceed with any of the conflicting snapshots. 5. Test with 2 matching + 1 conflicting and verify majority handling.
executable_checks: Provide 3 conflicting snapshots and assert fallback to EL replay
Verify client does not proceed with unverified snapshot
Verify full deposit log replay produces correct tree state
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP4881-INV-005. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-HONEST-PEER-ASSUMPTION. Related: ASSUM-EIP4881-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: RLP encoding of Cancun blocks produces non-deterministic output
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a Cancun block with all field types populated. 2. RLP-encode the block 100 times. Verify all outputs are byte-identical. 3. Decode and re-encode the block. Verify round-trip produces identical bytes. 4. RLP-encode on two different client implementations. Verify identical output. 5. Test with edge cases: empty transactions list, maximum withdrawals, zero-value fields.
executable_checks: RLP-encode same block 100 times and assert all outputs identical
RLP round-trip (encode-decode-encode) and assert identical bytes
Compare RLP output across 2+ implementations
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CANCUNBLK-INV-004. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-RLP-ENCODING. Related: ASSUM-CANCUN-BLOCKS-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: Validator client fails to detect new genesis after testnet reset
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Run a validator client on testnet instance A. 2. Trigger testnet reset creating instance B with new genesis. 3. Restart the validator client. 4. Verify it detects the new genesis automatically. 5. Verify stale state from instance A is purged. 6. Verify the client begins validating on instance B without manual intervention.
executable_checks: Reset testnet and restart validator; assert new genesis detection
Verify old chain data is purged after reset detection
Verify client participates in new chain without manual config
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP6916-INV-006. Invariant falsification. Primary element: ACTION-REINITIALIZE. Related: ASSUM-EIP6916-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Callee can read or write caller's memory space
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Contract A writes 0xDEAD to memory offset 0. 2. Contract A calls Contract B via CALL. 3. In Contract B, MLOAD offset 0 and verify it returns 0 (not 0xDEAD). 4. Contract B writes 0xBEEF to offset 0. 5. After B returns, A MLOADs offset 0 and verifies it still contains 0xDEAD (not 0xBEEF). 6. Test with STATICCALL and verify same isolation. 7. Test DELEGATECALL and verify it shares caller's memory (expected behavior).
executable_checks: CALL: verify callee cannot read caller's memory
CALL: verify callee's writes do not affect caller's memory
DELEGATECALL: verify memory is shared (distinct from CALL isolation)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EVMMEM-INV-005. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-CONTEXT-ISOLATION. Related: ASSUM-MEMORY-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Pairing precompile returns value other than 0x01 or 0x00
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute pairing check with a known-valid pairing. Verify exactly 32 bytes returned with last byte = 0x01. 2. Execute with known-invalid pairing. Verify 32 bytes with last byte = 0x00. 3. Execute with empty input (0 pairs). Verify return value (should be 0x01 per convention). 4. Verify return is exactly 32 bytes (not 1 byte, not 64 bytes). 5. Verify leading 31 bytes are all zeros.
executable_checks: Valid pairing: assert return == 0x00...01 (32 bytes)
Invalid pairing: assert return == 0x00...00 (32 bytes)
Verify return length is exactly 32 bytes
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP196-POSTCOND-003. Post-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-PAIRING-CHECK.

checklist.title: Falsify: Finalized deposit count decreases after finalization advance
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Record finalized deposit count at epoch E. 2. Advance finalization to epoch E+1. 3. Record new finalized deposit count. Verify it is >= previous count. 4. Verify all deposits up to new finalized index have valid Merkle proofs against the new finalized root. 5. Attempt to artificially decrease the finalized count and verify protection.
executable_checks: Record count at E, advance to E+1, assert count(E+1) >= count(E)
Verify Merkle proofs for all deposits up to new finalized index
Assert finalized count cannot decrease
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP4881-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-ADVANCE-FINALIZATION.

checklist.title: Falsify: Beacon block root not stored in beacon roots contract after block validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Process a valid Cancun block with known parent_beacon_block_root. 2. Query the beacon roots contract (0x000F3df6D732807Ef1319fB7B8bB8522d0Beac02) using the block's timestamp. 3. Verify the stored root matches parent_beacon_block_root from the header. 4. Process a second block and verify its root is also stored at its timestamp. 5. Verify previous block's root is still accessible.
executable_checks: After block processing, query beacon roots contract and assert root matches header
Verify root persistence across multiple blocks
Verify timestamp-based indexing returns correct root
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CANCUNBLK-POSTCOND-003. Post-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-STORE-BEACON-ROOT.

checklist.title: Falsify: Access list entries not pre-warmed, charged at cold cost
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a transaction with an access list containing address A and storage key K. 2. During execution, access A's storage key K. 3. Measure gas cost and verify it is 100 (warm) not 2600 (cold). 4. Access a key NOT in the access list and verify cold cost (2600). 5. Verify the access list pre-warming occurs before any EVM execution.
executable_checks: Access listed storage key and assert gas cost == 100
Access unlisted storage key and assert gas cost == 2600
Verify pre-warming happens before first opcode execution
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7928-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition falsification. Primary element: STATE-ACCESS-LIST-APPLIED.

checklist.title: Falsify: MSTORE does not write big-endian 32 bytes or fails to expand memory
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. MSTORE value 0x0102030405...1F20 at offset 0. 2. MLOAD at offset 0 and verify returned value matches. 3. Verify individual bytes via MLOAD at offsets 0-31 match big-endian layout. 4. MSTORE at offset 64 (expanding memory). Verify MSIZE returns >= 96. 5. MSTORE at offset 0 when memory was previously size 0. Verify expansion to >= 32.
executable_checks: MSTORE then MLOAD and assert round-trip equality
Verify big-endian byte layout in memory
MSTORE at new offset and assert MSIZE >= offset+32
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EVMMEM-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-MSTORE.

checklist.title: Falsify: Light client finalized header regresses to earlier slot
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Apply a valid LightClientUpdate advancing finalized header to slot S. 2. Apply another valid update with finalized header at slot S-1. 3. Verify the update is rejected or the stored header remains at slot S. 4. Apply update with finalized header at slot S+1. Verify acceptance. 5. Verify the stored finalized header monotonically advances.
executable_checks: Apply update to slot S, then attempt update to S-1, assert rejection
Apply update to slot S+1 and assert acceptance
Verify stored finalized slot never decreases
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-DENEBLCP2P-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition falsification. Primary element: STATE-LC-FINALIZED-HEADER.

checklist.title: Falsify: ECMUL scalar not reduced modulo curve order for large values
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute ECMUL with scalar = curve_order + 1. Verify result equals 1*G (the generator). 2. Execute ECMUL with scalar = 0. Verify result is point at infinity (0,0). 3. Execute with scalar = curve_order. Verify result is point at infinity. 4. Execute with scalar = 2^256 - 1 (max uint256). Verify result matches expected reduced computation. 5. Verify big-endian interpretation by using scalars that differ in endianness.
executable_checks: ECMUL(G, curve_order+1) == ECMUL(G, 1) assert equal
ECMUL(G, 0) == (0,0) assert point at infinity
ECMUL(G, curve_order) == (0,0) assert point at infinity
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP196-PRECOND-002. Pre-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-PARSE-SCALAR.

checklist.title: Falsify: Block with unknown parent processed instead of deferred
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a Cancun block whose parent_hash references a block NOT in the database. 2. Verify the block is NOT processed and is queued/deferred. 3. Subsequently provide the parent block. 4. Verify the previously deferred block is now processed. 5. Verify no state changes occurred during the deferred period.
executable_checks: Submit block with unknown parent and assert deferral (not rejection)
Provide parent block and verify deferred block is processed
Verify no state mutation during deferral
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CANCUNBLK-PRECOND-005. Pre-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-CHECK-PARENT.

checklist.title: Falsify: Block exceeds dynamically adjusted maximum blob gas limit
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute the dynamic blob gas limit for the current block based on recent usage. 2. Submit a block with total_blob_gas exceeding this dynamic limit. 3. Verify block rejection. 4. Submit a block at exactly the limit. Verify acceptance. 5. Submit a block below the limit. Verify acceptance. 6. Verify the dynamic adjustment tracks recent block blob usage correctly.
executable_checks: Submit block exceeding dynamic blob limit and assert rejection
Submit block at exactly dynamic limit and assert acceptance
Verify dynamic limit computation from recent block history
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7928-INV-004. Invariant falsification. Primary element: STATE-DYNAMIC-BLOB-LIMIT.

checklist.title: Falsify: MSTORE8 modifies bytes beyond the target offset
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Write known pattern (0xFF) to memory offsets 0-31 using MSTORE. 2. Execute MSTORE8 at offset 16 with value 0x42. 3. MLOAD at offset 0 and verify only byte 16 changed to 0x42; bytes 0-15 and 17-31 remain 0xFF. 4. Test MSTORE8 at offset 0 (boundary). 5. Test MSTORE8 at the current memory size boundary (triggers expansion).
executable_checks: Write pattern, MSTORE8 at mid-offset, verify only target byte changed
MSTORE8 at offset 0 and verify byte 0 changed, bytes 1-31 unchanged
MSTORE8 at expansion boundary and verify correct single-byte write
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EVMMEM-POSTCOND-004. Post-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-MSTORE8.

checklist.title: Falsify: Coordinate >= field prime p accepted by EIP-196 precompile
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ECADD with x-coordinate = p (the field prime exactly). Verify failure. 2. Call with x-coordinate = p + 1. Verify failure. 3. Call with x-coordinate = p - 1 (valid). Verify acceptance. 4. Call with y-coordinate = p. Verify failure. 5. Test with both coordinates at maximum (2^256 - 1). Verify failure.
executable_checks: ECADD with coordinate == p and assert failure
ECADD with coordinate == p-1 and valid point, assert success
ECADD with coordinate == 2^256-1 and assert failure
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP196-PRECOND-003. Pre-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-CHECK-FIELD-ELEMENT.
